# zeroword_environment_settings (Resource)

Management settings of one Environment. Every Environment always has settings, so destroying this resource resets them to the defaults (`impersonation_enabled = false`).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "zeroword_environment_settings" "staging" {
  environment_id        = zeroword_environment.staging.id
  impersonation_enabled = false
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `environment_id` (String) Environment ID (`env_...`).
- `impersonation_enabled` (Boolean) Whether Owner/Admin Dashboard sessions may impersonate users of this Environment.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The import ID is the Environment ID.
terraform import zeroword_environment_settings.staging env_xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
```
